parties.petitioner: Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences & Anr.

summary: Retirement age extension for AYUSH doctors; central government policy to enhance superannuation age to 65 years for AYUSH doctors working directly under MoA & CGHS; autonomous bodies excluded; respondent sought extension beyond 60; CAT & High Court directed benefit to be granted; Supreme Court examined applicability of DoPT notifications & Ministry clarifications; distinction between direct employees vs autonomous bodies; eligibility criteria for retirement age enhancement.
legal_provisions_cited: Department of Personnel and Training O.M. No. 25012/8/98-Estt. (A)
final_judgment: Not explicitly stated in provided text, but implied review of High Court's order allowing writ application.
